stories.title: Global bond sell-off intensifies, as UK long-term borrowing costs pass 6%

en.title: Global bond sell-off intensifies, as UK long-term borrowing costs pass 6%
en.summary: Bond markets worldwide are experiencing heightened volatility as investors worry about unsustainable US deficit levels and the risk of persistent inflation from elevated oil prices, pushing UK government borrowing costs to their highest in 28 years.

en.title: Trump doesn't rule out sending ICE to polling sites; US supreme court to review policy to detain immigrants challenging deportation – live
en.summary: The US Supreme Court is examining whether immigrants have the right to hearings regarding detention while contesting deportation proceedings. Separately, the White House removed CNN from the rotating press pool for presidential travel.

stories.title: Former Wallaby hooker Nathan Charles diagnosed with MND at 37

en.title: Former Wallaby hooker Nathan Charles diagnosed with MND at 37
en.summary: Nathan Charles, a former Australian rugby international who was the first person with cystic fibrosis to play professional contact sport, has been diagnosed with motor neurone disease at age 37.

en.title: Heeney wins Swans' best and fairest, says he 'can't wait' to return next season
en.summary: Isaac Heeney claimed the Bob Skilton Medal for the third consecutive year as the Sydney Swans' best and fairest. The club leadership stated that players involved in a recent hotel scandal warrant presumption of innocence.

stories.title: Tennessee governor suspends all executions after Christa Pike’s lethal injections fail

en.title: Tennessee governor suspends all executions after Christa Pike's lethal injections fail
en.summary: Tennessee's governor has suspended all executions through at least the end of the year and ordered an independent inquiry following a failed execution attempt. Condemned inmate Christa Pike remained conscious approximately 40 minutes after receiving two doses of lethal injection.

en.title: Zach Merrett wins Essendon's best and fairest as trade war with Hawks resumes

en.title: Chris Fagan steps down as Brisbane Lions coach after historic AFL premiership three-peat
